Description: Susceptible humans become exposed to the Zika virus through bites from infectious mosquitoes.
Exposed humans progress to the infectious stage after an incubation period.
Infectious humans recover from the disease.
Vector eggs hatch and become larvae.
Vector pupae emerge as susceptible female adult mosquitoes.

Name: β
Description: The percentage of bites that transmit ZIKV.

Name: α_H
Description: The inverse incubation time of ZIKV for human.

Name: γ
Description: The recovery rate of an infectious individual.

Name: K_H
Description: Carrying capacity of the human population.

Name: e_V
Description: The number of eggs laid per female mosquito per unit time.

Name: α_V
Description: The inverse incubation time of ZIKV in vectors.
